raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "pay the building tax for"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "the apartment at str. Zorilor nr. 12, bl. C3, ap. 41, Cluj-Napoca"
  role object "486 lei"
  role time "28.03.2026"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s2 stated
  relation "receive a discount of"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "10 percent"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s3 stated
  relation "pay separately for"
  role subject "the user's husband"
  role object "the garage"
  role object "74 lei"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s4 stated
  relation "receive a discount of"
  role subject "the user's husband"
  role object "10 percent"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@q query
  select ?total
  where match
    relation "be the total amount before discount"
    role object ?total
    polarity affirmed
  end

@c constraint
  var ?x1 int
  var ?x2 int
  var ?total int
  require ?x1 equal 486 times 100 divided_by 90
  require ?x2 equal 74 times 100 divided_by 90
  require ?total equal ?x1 plus ?x2
  task prove
  select ?total
